NewsArticle.Title: Political Rituals
NewsArticle.Content:
New Guards and Demagogues learn the ritual of Mileth Law and Mileth Politics respectively. These rituals may be used in any non-mundane area. This allows for convenient law enforcement or political activity away from the village hall.
Like lectures, it is begun by dropping a coin below where you begin the ritual. Unlike lectures, the coin must be placed exactly where you stand.
Current active Guards and Demagogues learn this ritual when entering Temuair.
See [political features](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_politics.html) and [all features.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
